rationale_md: Switzerland enters this Group B clash as clear favorites, backed by a substantial 140-point Elo rating advantage over Bosnia-Herzegovina that reflects their stronger recent form and competitive pedigree. The Swiss side's technical superiority and tournament experience should prove decisive against a Bosnian team that has struggled to maintain consistency at the international level. While Bosnia-Herzegovina possesses individual talent capable of causing problems, the rating gap suggests Switzerland should control proceedings and secure all three points to strengthen their position in the group standings.
